acs.text_first_line: AC1 The first deviation publishes one hold with its handler and its return point
AC2 A second deviation keeps the hold and counts
AC3 The hold lifts only at the last clear
AC4 The clear records the outcome and the act never moves the case
AC5 The lists and the count come from their owners and a repeat writes once
AC6 The record and the event commit together
AC7 The act is guarded and no hold leaves without a right
AC8 The queue-write path needs no operation of this service
